LEARNING PATH · CLASS 47 · CARING FOR OUR PLANET · AGES 4–5

Caring for Our Planet — thirty printable eco flashcards for kids.

Thirty printable caring-for-our-planet flashcards for ages four to five, all on this one page, in five shelves: the planting shelf, the critter shelf, the recycle shelf, the power-down shelf and the every-day shelf. Every card shows five small eco actions a child can do TODAY — plant a tree, close the tap, rescue a bee, sort the waste, turn off the light — with Download and Print buttons right under the picture. Small actions, big difference: pick a card, do one thing, and the planet says thank you.

Back to the Learning Path ↗
HOW THIS CLASS WORKS

One small action. Your hands do it. The planet feels it.

Caring for our planet is the first science a child can DO with their whole body — before the words ecosystem or compost, comes the feeling of dropping one peel into the compost bin and watching it become soil. Every card in this class prints five small actions in one cheerful color family: the planting cards grow things, the critter cards feed and rescue animals, the recycle cards sort the world into paper, glass and treasure, the power-down cards flip switches off, and the every-day cards ride along from breakfast to bedtime. You do not need a plan — you need a watering can, a windowsill and maybe one very brave worm.

The shelves follow a green day. Planting starts with dirt under the fingernails — a tree, some bulbs, a pollinator patch. The Critter Shelf makes you the hero of the birds, the bees and the earthworms. The Recycle Shelf turns the bins into a sorting relay. Power-Down hunts the switches and taps that secretly sip. And the Every-Day Shelf carries the small stuff — a lunchbox packed with pride, a bike washed with a bucket, seeds saved from tonight’s dinner. Do one card a day and by summer the whole street is greener.

THE PLANTING SHELF · 6 CARDS

Get your hands in the dirt.

Printable planting flashcards for preschool: plant a tree, plant bulbs, plant shrubs, plant a pollinator patch, collect the rain and restore a habitat — the caring-for-our-planet cards that start as seeds and end as shade, flowers and homes for wild things. Every card shows five labeled eco actions, carries its four pills — age, subject, grade level, skill — and downloads and prints straight from this page at its own size: seven of the cards are wide, the rest are tall, and each one keeps its true shape.

AROUND THE SCHOOL

Where the green habits grow up.

Science, Nature & Discovery in Class 31 · Ages 4–5 ↗Animals & Their Habitats in Class 36 · Ages 4–5 ↗Our Earth & Space in Class 43 · Ages 4–5 ↗The Learning Path ↗

Class 31 runs the experiments — sink or float, seeds sprouting, the water cycle — and this class turns those discoveries into daily habits. Class 36 walks through the habitats — the meadow, the pond, the ice — and the Critter Shelf here is where you become those animals’ helper. Class 43 flies up to the whole blue planet, and this class is where the blue planet gets personal: your tap, your tree, your street. And when you want the next class, the Learning Path holds all forty-nine in order — and the whole deck prints again from the Caring for Our Planet parents’ shelf.

Small actions, big difference. Every card here hands you one thing the planet can feel by tonight — a seed in the ground, a tap closed tight, a bee rescued with a glass and a steady hand. That is the whole lesson, and it is already yours.
